degree_required.quote: Received a baccalaureate or postbaccalaureate degree from a regionally accredited United States college or university with a program in human nutrition, food and nutrition, dietetics, or food systems management

required.quote: Completed a planned, continuous preprofessional experience component in dietetic practice of not fewer than nine hundred (900) hours under the supervision of a registered dietitian or licensed dietitian

duration.quote: not fewer than nine hundred (900) hours

interval_years.quote: The license of a licensed dietitian shall be ruled valid for one (1) year after the date of issuance.

required.quote: Require at the time of license renewal each applicant to present satisfactory evidence that in the period since the license was issued he or she has completed the continuing education requirements in a manner specified by the board.

available.quote: Reciprocity shall be provided for licensed dietitians from other states, provided that the standards for licensing in that state are not less than those provided for in this chapter

requirements.value: Standards for licensing in the other state must be not less than those required under Arkansas law, as determined by the Arkansas Dietetics Licensing Board.

title_protection.quote: Representing oneself to be a dietitian or licensed dietitian, using the words "dietitian" or "provisional licensed dietitian" alone or in combination, or using the initials, "L.D." or "P.L.D." or any other letters, words, abbreviations, or insignia indicating that he or she is a dietitian, unless he or she is duly licensed as such under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of a provision of this chapter

definition_quote.value: the integration and application of the principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, food, physiology, management, and behavioral and social sciences to achieve and maintain people's health through the provision of nutrition care services
definition_quote.quote: "Dietetics practice" means the integration and application of the principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, food, physiology, management, and behavioral and social sciences to achieve and maintain people's health through the provision of nutrition care services

value: Assessing nutritional needs of individuals and groups
Establishing priorities, goals, and objectives for nutritional needs
Providing nutrition counseling in health and disease
Developing, implementing, and managing nutrition care and food service systems
Evaluating and maintaining standards of quality in food and nutrition care services
methods_authorized.quote: "Nutrition care services" means: (A) Assessing the nutritional needs of individuals and groups of humans ... (B) Establishing priorities, goals, and objectives ... (C) Providing nutrition counseling to humans in health and disease; (D) Developing, implementing, and managing nutrition care of, and food service systems for, humans; and (E) Evaluating, making changes in, and maintaining appropriate standards of quality in food and nutrition care services for humans

value: licensed dietitian
provisionally licensed dietitian
license_type_structure.quote: "Licensed dietitian" means a person licensed under this chapter ... "Provisionally licensed dietitian" means a person provisionally licensed under this chapter

provisional_license_available.quote: A provisional license to practice as a dietitian may be issued by the Arkansas Dietetics Licensing Board upon the filing of an application and submission of evidence of successful completion of the education requirements.

provisional_license_duration_months.quote: A provisional license shall expire eighteen (18) months from the date of issuance.

provisional_license_requires_supervision.quote: A provisional license shall permit the holder to practice only under the supervision of a dietitian licensed in this state.

dietetic_technician_recognized.quote: "Dietetic technician" means one who has completed a dietetic technician program and has received a two-year associate degree from a regionally accredited college or university

rd_credential_accepted_in_lieu_of_state_.quote: The applicant files an application and provides evidence of current registration as a registered dietitian by the Commission on Dietetic Registration.

enteral_parenteral_nutrition_authorized.quote: "Nutritional assessment" means the evaluation of the nutritional needs of individuals and groups, based upon appropriate biochemical, anthropometric, physical, and dietary data, to determine nutrient needs and recommend appropriate nutritional intervention, including enteral and parenteral nutrition

exempt_professions_list.quote: This chapter does not affect or prevent: (1) Dietetics students ... (2) A dietitian who is serving in the armed forces ... (4) A licensed physician, pharmacist, or nurse ... (12) A healthcare professional or nutritionist from engaging in dietetics practice without a license under this chapter

federal_employee_exemption.quote: A dietitian who is serving in the armed forces or the United States Public Health Service or is employed by the Department of Veterans Affairs from engaging in the practice of dietetics, provided that the practice is related to that service or employment

weight_control_program_exemption.quote: A person who offers weight control programs prepared under the supervision of or approved by a registered dietitian or a licensed dietitian who is licensed under the laws of this state or another state that has licensure requirements at least as stringent as the requirements of this chapter

food_supplement_sales_exemption.quote: The sale of vitamins, over-the-counter healthcare products, or food supplements by persons who are not licensed under this chapter

animal_nutrition_exemption.quote: A person who has received a doctoral degree from a regionally accredited United States college or university in or with a concentration in animal nutrition and whose practice is related to the degree

nonresident_temporary_practice_allowed.quote: A nonresident dietitian practicing dietetics in this state, if: (A) The dietetics are performed for no more than one hundred eighty (180) consecutive working days

nonresident_temporary_practice_max_days.quote: The dietetics are performed for no more than one hundred eighty (180) consecutive working days
